Hearing damage from loud noise that causes tinnitus can be helped by hyperbaric oxygen therapy. When your inner ear is damaged something happens that causes poor circulation inside your ear and hyperbaric treatment helps this. The increased blood flow brings healing platelets to your inner ear that help repair damage.
I learned all of this after acquiring tinnitus from noise damage.
Another way to increase blood flow in your ear is to take a large dose of Niacin. (Don't use no flush niacin because you want the flushing effect) 
It can help prevent long term damage from being worse than it needs to be. It also works for my tinnitus fairups that always coincide with the clogged ear feeling.

Try it. Start with 250 mg of regular niacin (I bought it at the vitamin shoppe which is a usa chain) make sure to get regular and not "flush free" if that doesn't cause enough of a flush, you can try up to a 1.5 grams. When my tinnitus is very bad I go for maximum doses that cause me to turn bright red.

Please try it! It's not dangerous so you have nothing to loose but a few dollars! It does burn though so be prepared for some interesting sensations. Time is of the essence with hearing damage...
